When a candidate fails its proof (or a secret refusal hits it at :591), `taken.discard(tid)` hands the same id to the next candidate. A build-time skip (refactor: "no test at the parent names a touched file") or a build-time secret refusal still uses up one of the N slots, and no later candidate fills it. This breaks the documented contract: seed-refactor-tasks.sh:36-37 says a commit without a covering test "is skipped and does not count", and seed-bugfix-tasks.sh:43-44 says "refusals and skips do not count". 7	``` text
8	head/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh:576 — Fence regression (classifier on vs. off): `_bdb_hd_scan_body` keeps a body segment only when its first word is a fence verb, so a destructive command behind a shell keyword (`if true; then rm -rf src; fi`, `for d in src; do rm -rf $d; done`, `while :; do …`, `case … ) rm -rf src;;`, `f() { rm -rf src; }; f`, `else rm …`) is dropped entirely instead of forcing a full scan.
